items.text: the sound shelf leads with what you play with (tap, when, wet, react, touch), then the mixer; bringing sounds in (mic, track, pack) moves to the right end
Pack opens on its name in large type and what it is for (bring in your own sounds), with a link to the sound pack guide; the shelf's pack button now wears the same box as the Pack tab

if the page is ever closed by the phone while you play, it now says so by itself the next time it opens: a short report goes to the studio with what was happening, so the cause can be found without you sending anything
the tap button shows the tempo before you tap: the beat that plays is in its label, and its dot blinks on each beat
pointing at a button in the index's toolbar (the manual, above all) no longer shakes the panel up and down

joining the Founders Club is a celebration: your name in big letters, your founder number, a thank-you from Dimitry, the climb to 100, what comes next, and two bursts of confetti. It stays until you close it
invite a friend to join, straight from the welcome
on the cover, the Founders Club invitation is a frosted pane with a light running round its edge, breathing like the sound button
the Pack panel is a browser: the studio's packs shown by kind or all, grouped by kind or A to Z, like the scenes
Water is in the library as its own pack (the default, opened in its tab), beside the Frost Water starter, which you can add in one tap
how the Pack works is behind an i beside its heading; importing a file or a folder are two round buttons at the top right
in the Founders Club, when there is room, the portrait sits under the quote, above the name
the keys sheet lines its groups up: every heading starts on the same line, and each group's keys flow into its own columns beneath it
Play with, at the foot of the keys sheet: Keys today, MIDI and OSC coming with Pro
every tabbed panel names its page at the top (Capture, Batch, Scenes, Auto play, Mic, Mixer and the rest); the tabs stay at the foot as its menu
choices look like choices: Batch's options and the presets in the Sound panel are pills, the chosen one filled
Batch is a tab of the capture panel, beside Capture: go back and forth without closing anything
on a computer, resting the pointer on the capture button shows the shot in the shape you picked, with its size; a still flies up from it into the share sheet
a video stops by itself at its length, picked beside the modes in Capture: 15 s, 30 s, or 1 min on a computer or tablet
a video that runs until you stop it
while a video or a GIF records, a small window above the bar shows what is being recorded, in its shape, with the time on its lower edge; tap it to stop
